summary.key_theme: 市場在 AI 相關支出與高估值擔憂下出現震盪，但長期投資者仍視回調為買入機會，整體多空觀點分歧。

bullish.title: It's Time To Go All-In On Stocks

bullish.title: The Stock Market Has Boomed After the Last 19 Midterms

bullish.title: This Is Why I'm Buying The Halloween Dip
